readiness_contract.description: Additive normalized readiness view for cross-profile human-review routing. Built from existing response fields; does not replace profile-specific fields and does not imply approval, clearance, advice, factual verification, or autonomous decision-making.

outputSchema.description: Product-grade structured response contract for Kazakhstan / Middle Corridor deal-risk evidence triage. This schema supports source-coverage gaps, escalation routing, watch-next indicators, and human-review requirements. It does not provide legal advice, sanctions advice, compliance advice, financial advice, investment advice, insurance advice, trading advice, live retrieval, or factual-truth verification.

examples.not_advice_notice: Pre-compliance evidence triage only. Not legal, sanctions, compliance, financial, investment, insurance, or trading advice.

operational_decision.rationale: Route to compliance or legal before you quote / sign the booking.

top_risks: Caspian crossing capacity and draft exposure
watch_next: Caspian ferry-slot, tonnage, or draft notice

counterparty_readiness.description: Outward-facing reframe of the evidence-gap picture for the party that must PRESENT a due-diligence dossier to a bank, insurer, or counterparty under enhanced due diligence, rather than the internal analyst deciding whether to escalate. Derived from the required-before-go contract and supplied sources. Dossier-completeness only; not clearance, approval, a sanctions determination, or compliance advice.

document_ledger.description: Per-required-document ledger mirroring the EDD chain-of-custody practice of tracking each item with the date it was received. One entry per required-before-go source type. date_received is the earliest supplied dated source of that type, when present. Status tracking only; not verification of the document's contents or authenticity.

customs_harmonization_indicators.description: Standing customs-regime review checklist for the route: permitting clarity, and harmonized digital-customs coverage (eTIR; adopted by Organization of Turkic States members) versus unharmonized national permitting that remains a recurring barrier to private-sector corridor use. Evidence-gap prompts routed to human review; not customs, legal, or compliance advice. Does not affect the decision-readiness score.

decision_readiness_score.description: Heuristic 0-100 score for evidence-pack readiness for human review. This is not approval, clearance, legal advice, sanctions advice, compliance advice, financial advice, investment advice, insurance advice, or trading advice.

exposure_layers.description: Risk picture decomposed into the two layers a practitioner separates: home-jurisdiction legal / documentation posture (not assessed by this product) versus foreign / secondary-sanctions exposure. Structural decomposition only; not a legal or sanctions determination.

front_company_indicators.description: Front-company / business-substance checklist surfaced when business-substance evidence is not yet supplied. An evidence-gap checklist routed to human review (drawn from EU Sanctions Helpdesk counterparty red flags: recently established or no business background, little or no web presence, shared addresses, line-of-business mismatch, contact only via broad power of attorney); not a shell-company determination, an ownership determination, live retrieval, or legal advice. Does not affect the decision-readiness score.

link_integrity.description: Observe-only structural lint of cited source-URL well-formedness. Present only when at least one supplied source carries a malformed or placeholder URL. Structural check only: it does not fetch URLs, verify that a page exists, perform live retrieval, or verify factual content. It does not change the triage recommendation, risk signal, operational decision, or evidence gaps.

operational_decision.description: Logistics/ops-facing booking decision derived from the decision-readiness score, risk signal, triage recommendation, and decision stage. Triage routing only; not clearance, approval, a sanctions determination, or any legal, sanctions, compliance, financial, investment, insurance, or trading advice. It never issues a hard reject (a compliance/legal call) and stops at hold or escalate. Human review is required before any commercial action.

pep_screening_indicators.description: Politically-exposed-person (PEP) screening checklist surfaced when PEP-screening evidence is not yet supplied. An evidence-gap checklist routed to human review (drawn from FATF Recommendations 12 and 22); not a PEP determination, a political-exposure judgment, live retrieval, or legal advice. Does not affect the decision-readiness score.

reexport_control_indicators.description: End-use / end-user verification checklist surfaced when end-user or no-re-export evidence is not yet supplied. An evidence-gap checklist routed to human review (drawn from EU Sanctions Helpdesk and US end-user diversion red flags); not an end-use determination, sanctions determination, live retrieval, or legal advice. Does not affect the decision-readiness score.

route_sanctions_exposure_indicators.description: Standing route-screening checklist of Middle Corridor connections that carry elevated sanctions-program exposure: Iran-transit legs and Russia Northern Corridor overlaps (OFAC Iran and Russia programs), sanctioned Caspian operators, and onward connections into a sanctions-relevant jurisdiction. Presence-flagging routed to human review; not a sanctions determination, live screening, or legal advice.

route_sanctions_matched_segments.description: Corridor segments named in the declared route text that match a sanctions-exposed connection on the screening checklist. Case-insensitive substring presence-flagging on the route string only, routed to human review; not a sanctions determination or live screening. Does not affect the decision-readiness score.

run_provenance.description: Deterministic content-provenance stamp: which contract version and response schema produced this output, plus a digest of the exact request input. Lets a downstream reviewer (compliance committee, bank, auditor) confirm the artifact is reproducible from a named input and ruleset. Reproducibility / traceability only; not a signature of authenticity (that is the A2A / JWS transport layer, ADR 0017), and not a factuality, clearance, or compliance attestation.

contract_version.description: Version of the agenda-intelligence package / ruleset that produced this response.

input_digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalized request JSON (UTF-8, keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace). Same input + same contract_version reproduces the same digest.

schema_id.description: The $id of the response schema this output conforms to.

source_of_funds_indicators.description: Source-of-funds / source-of-wealth verification checklist surfaced when source-of-funds-or-wealth evidence is not yet supplied. An evidence-gap checklist routed to human review (drawn from FATF Recommendation 10 EDD guidance); not a financial determination, AML clearance, live retrieval, or financial advice. Does not affect the decision-readiness score.

vessel_due_diligence_indicators.description: Deceptive-shipping-practice (DSP) verification checklist surfaced for the maritime leg when vessel / carrier history is not yet supplied. An evidence-gap checklist routed to human review (drawn from OFAC maritime guidance); not vessel adjudication, AIS analysis, live retrieval, or insurance advice.
